title: ALL () with no arguments cannot be used as a table expression

expected.error: ALL () with no arguments can only be used as a CALCULATE or CALCULATETABLE modifier; it does not return a table

source.quote: ALL() can only be used to clear filters but not to return a table.
ALL can be used as a table expression when it has at least one argument.
source.supports: ALL is a table expression only when it has at least one argument
